name: Kadogawa (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Kadogawa town emblem in yellow: a stylised angular device of horizontal strokes, like a letter K.
history: Municipal flag of Kadogawa, a town in Miyazaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 November 1968; the emblem dates from February 1955.

features.role: Kadogawa town emblem — a stylised angular device of horizontal strokes, like a letter K
